# Generated by ppc finalize (job_room.py); do not edit by hand.
# Location scope. pp_job_room_open_<class>: the jobs for the class in the open buildings here that nobody fills,
# in thousands. pp_job_room_left_<class>: those the start step has not filled yet (the setup's groups come
# first). pp_job_room_share_<class>: the share of the location's peasants that fills them, at most 0.9.
pp_job_room_open_burghers = {
	value = 0
	every_buildings_in_location = {
		limit = { building_pop_type = burghers is_opened = yes }
		add = { value = building_employment_size_amount subtract = building_employed_amount min = 0 }
	}
}
pp_job_room_left_burghers = {
	value = pp_job_room_open_burghers
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_job_room_done_burghers }
		subtract = var:pp_job_room_done_burghers
	}
	min = 0
}
pp_job_room_share_burghers = {
	value = pp_job_room_left_burghers
	divide = { value = num_pop_type:peasants min = 0.001 }
	min = 0
	max = 0.9
}
# Location scope: the laborers at work in the buildings here, in thousands (pp_job_room_trim).
pp_job_room_at_work_laborers = {
	value = 0
	every_buildings_in_location = {
		limit = { building_pop_type = laborers }
		add = building_employed_amount
	}
}
